title: REQ · Generator carries animations and origin into manifest entries and boy sources are registered
summary: ArtSource gains optional animations and origin; generateAssets copies them; ART_SOURCES lists boy sources
description: Context: ArtSource (src/art/sources.ts) has only id, path, frames, and generateAssets (src/lib/generateAssets.ts) emits entries without animations or origin. Desired behavior: optional fields copied to spritesheet entries; boy sheet declares idle [0-3], walk [4-9], interact [10-13] with rates and origin {0.5,1}; both boy sources added to ART_SOURCES. Expected result: generated entries pass parseManifest.
acceptance_criteria: Given a source with animations and origin, when generateAssets runs, then the entry has the same animations and origin
Given a source without them, when generateAssets runs, then the entry has neither key
Given ART_SOURCES, when ids are listed, then they include the boy sheet and portrait ids once each
Given the boy sheet entry, when read, then frameCount is 14 and animations idle, walk, interact cover frames 0-3, 4-9, 10-13

in_scope: animation declarations on the boy sheet source
preserve: existing entry shape for sources without new fields

technical_constraints: Manifest animation shape must match animationSchema in game/src/assets/manifest/schema.ts
definition_of_done: Generated boy entries validate against manifestSchema
